quantileConvention: linear interpolation at (n-1)*q for synthetic QA; production/research receipt must freeze one convention before use

fixtures.conclusion: Low dispersion can coexist with broad bullish synchronization.
The exact same zero-dispersion state can coexist with broad bearish synchronization; dispersion has no sign by itself.
CSSD/CSAD can look high while median-based MAD stays zero; one extreme member can dominate non-robust dispersion.
High dispersion can reflect genuine two-sided disagreement even when average return is exactly zero.
Multiple robust/non-robust measures agree more closely when dispersion is distributed rather than driven by one extreme member.

productionResearchRules: Freeze quantile convention before any live IQR comparison.
Report member count and return coverage.
Leader-removal must be selected by pre-return tradeValue, never realized return.
No threshold sweep and no forward outcome join before source-only live receipt.
